contract: design-contract.md: private visitor reporting and attributable moderation in the existing OpenRaise review workspace, explicit restrictions and no automatic accusation-based decisions.

accessibility.evidence: axe WCAG2 A/AA and 2.1 AA: zero violations on moderation detail and public reporting form; labelled controls, confirmation and status/error feedback reviewed.

responsive.evidence: Desktop and 390px queue/detail/form use the expected grid and mobile stack, no document overflow. Private concern text wraps.

loading.evidence: Delayed moderation response shows Recording action… and disabled controls.

empty.evidence: No-match report search shows No matching reports with clear search.

error.evidence: Simulated stale 409 retains reason and offers reload; unavailable API shows retry state. Public unknown outcome keeps exact retry snapshot.

partial.evidence: Failed campaign photo shows shared gallery fallback without hiding allegation or controls.

success.evidence: Fixture report receipt, pause, freeze and resolution all succeed; resolution preserves restrictions.

permission.evidence: Non-admin denial and signed-out signin redirect checked in browser; API tests cover privacy and current role enforcement.

renderedEvidence.observation: Searchable reports queue, status filters and open count.
Private allegation separated from campaign context and current restrictions.
Report rows and workspace tabs fit mobile width.
Visitor category/detail fields, privacy explanation and private submit action.
Explicit action impact, reason and required acknowledgement.
